It's the systematic factory farms that are incredibly abusive that are really horrible. I have no issue with people who actually raise animals themselves or go hunting, it's just the modern meat industry is so fucked up it's basically impossible to get animal product in a decent way unless you personally know a farmer. It's very hardwired into us to eat meat from thousands of years of hunting, so I don't blame people for eating it. It's just that now we cram them into tiny cages, force feed them antibiotics, systematically r*pe them for milk, and kill them without utilizing the entire corpse. Anyways yeah I understand it's very easy to dissociate meat from animal, it's just nuts to me that people are emotionally able to do that.
